HYPERGEOMETRIC FUNCTIONS (p.562)
15.4.10  F(a, a+\tfrac12; c; z)=2^{c-1}\Gamma(c)z^{\tfrac12-\tfrac12c}(1-z)^{\tfrac12c-a-\tfrac12}P_{2a-c}^{1-c}[(1-z)^{-\tfrac12}] \quad (|\arg z|<\pi, |\arg (1-z)|<\pi, z not between 0 and -\infty)
15.4.11  F(a, a+\tfrac12; c; x)=2^{c-1}\Gamma(c)(-x)^{\tfrac12-\tfrac12c}(1-x)^{\tfrac12c-a-\tfrac12}P_{2a-c}^{1-c}[(1-x)^{-\tfrac12}] \quad (-\infty<x<0)
15.4.12  F(a, b; a+b+\tfrac12; z)=2^{a+b-\tfrac12}\Gamma(\tfrac12+a+b) (-z)^{\tfrac12(\tfrac12-a-b)}P_{a-b-\tfrac12}^{\tfrac12-a-b}[(1-z)^{\tfrac12}] \quad (|\arg (-z)|<\pi, z not between 0 and 1)
15.4.13  F(a, b; a+b+\tfrac12; x)=2^{a+b-\tfrac12}\Gamma(\tfrac12+a+b)x^{\tfrac12(\tfrac12-a-b)}P_{a-b-\tfrac12}^{\tfrac12-a-b}[(1-x)^{\tfrac12}] \quad (0<x<1)
15.4.14  F(a, b; a-b+1; z)=\Gamma(a-b+1)z^{\tfrac12b-\tfrac12a}(1-z)^{-b}P_{-b}^{b-a}\left(\frac{1+z}{1-z}\right) \quad (|\arg (1-z)|<\pi, z not between 0 and -\infty)
15.4.15  F(a, b; a-b+1; x)=\Gamma(a-b+1)(1-x)^{-b}(-x)^{\tfrac12b-\tfrac12a}P_{-b}^{b-a}\left(\frac{1+x}{1-x}\right) \quad (-\infty<x<0)
15.4.16  F(a, 1-a; c; z)=\Gamma(c)(-z)^{\tfrac12-\tfrac12c}(1-z)^{\tfrac12c-\tfrac12}P_{-a}^{1-c}(1-2z) \quad (|\arg (-z)|<\pi, |\arg (1-z)|<\pi, z not between 0 and 1)
15.4.17  F(a, 1-a; c; x)=\Gamma(c)x^{\tfrac12-\tfrac12c}(1-x)^{\tfrac12c-\tfrac12}P_{-a}^{1-c}(1-2x) \quad (0<x<1)
15.4.18  F(a, b; \tfrac12a+\tfrac12b+\tfrac12; z)=\Gamma(\tfrac12+\tfrac12a+\tfrac12b)[z(z-1)]^{\tfrac14(1-a-b)}P_{\tfrac12(a-b-1)}^{\tfrac12(1-a-b)}(1-2z) \quad (|\arg z|<\pi, |\arg (z-1)|<\pi, z not between 0 and 1)
15.4.19  F(a, b; \tfrac12a+\tfrac12b+\tfrac12; x)=\Gamma(\tfrac12+\tfrac12a+\tfrac12b)(x-x^2)^{\tfrac12(1-a-b)}P_{\tfrac12(a-b-1)}^{\tfrac12(1-a-b)}(1-2x) \quad (0<x<1)
15.4.20  F(a, b; a+b-\tfrac12; z)=2^{a+b-\tfrac32}\Gamma(a+b-\tfrac12)(-z)^{\tfrac12(\tfrac32-a-b)}(1-z)^{-\tfrac12}P_{b-a-\tfrac12}^{\tfrac32-a-b}[(1-z)^{\tfrac12}] \quad (|\arg (-z)|<\pi, |\arg (1-z)|<\pi, \Re[(1-z)^{\tfrac12}]>0, z not between 0 and 1)
15.4.21  F(a, b; a+b-\tfrac12; x)=2^{a+b-\tfrac32}\Gamma(a+b-\tfrac12)x^{\tfrac12(\tfrac32-a-b)}(1-x)^{-\tfrac12}P_{b-a-\tfrac12}^{\tfrac32-a-b}[(1-x)^{\tfrac12}] \quad (0<x<1)
15.4.22  F(a, b; \tfrac12; z)=\pi^{-\tfrac12}2^{a+b-\tfrac32}\Gamma(\tfrac12+a)\Gamma(\tfrac12+b)(z-1)^{\tfrac12(\tfrac12-a-b)}[P_{a-b-\tfrac12}^{\tfrac12-a-b}(z^{\tfrac12})+P_{a-b-\tfrac12}^{\tfrac12-a-b}(-z^{\tfrac12})] \quad (|\arg z|<\pi, |\arg(z-1)|<\pi, z not between 0 and 1)
15.4.23  F(a, b; \tfrac12; x)=\pi^{-\tfrac12}2^{a+b-\tfrac32}\Gamma(\tfrac12+a)\Gamma(\tfrac12+b)(1-x)^{\tfrac12(\tfrac12-a-b)}[P_{a-b-\tfrac12}^{\tfrac12-a-b}(x^{\tfrac12})+P_{a-b-\tfrac12}^{\tfrac12-a-b}(-x^{\tfrac12})] \quad (0<x<1)
15.4.24  F(a, b; \tfrac12; -z)=\pi^{-\tfrac12}2^{a-b-1}\Gamma(\tfrac12+a)\Gamma(1-b)(z+1)^{-\tfrac12a-\tfrac12b}e^{\pm i\tfrac{\pi}{2}(b-a)} \{P_{a+b-1}^{b-a}[z^{\tfrac12}(1+z)^{-\tfrac12}]+P_{a+b-1}^{b-a}[-z^{\tfrac12}(1+z)^{-\tfrac12}]\} \quad (\pm according as \Im z\gtreqless0, z not between 0 and \infty)
15.4.25  F(a, b; \tfrac12; -x)=\pi^{-\tfrac12}2^{a-b-1}\Gamma(\tfrac12+a)\Gamma(1-b)(1+x)^{-\tfrac12a-\tfrac12b} \{P_{a+b-1}^{b-a}[x^{\tfrac12}(1+x)^{-\tfrac12}]+P_{a+b-1}^{b-a}[-x(1+x)^{-\tfrac12}]\} \quad (0<x<\infty)
15.4.26  F(a, b; \tfrac32; x)=-\pi^{-\tfrac12}2^{a+b-\tfrac32}\Gamma(a-\tfrac12)\Gamma(b-\tfrac12)x^{-\tfrac12}(1-x)^{\tfrac12(\tfrac32-a-b)} \{P_{a-b-\tfrac12}^{\tfrac32-a-b}(x^{\tfrac12})-P_{a-b-\tfrac12}^{\tfrac32-a-b}(-x^{\tfrac12})\} \quad (0<x<1)
15.5. The Hypergeometric Differential Equation
The hypergeometric differential equation
15.5.1  z(1-z)\frac{d^2w}{dz^2}+[c-(a+b+1)z] \frac{dw}{dz}-abw=0
